why: Paragraph 28 has the stranger name the two Wessex Cup horses, 'Silver Blaze and Bayard', so the name is already used for this horse.

text: What did the stranger want at the stable? — get information to bet on
why: The stranger asks for 'the straight tip', asks whether Bayard could beat the other horse, and says the stable has bet on him, so information to bet on is a reasonable reading of what he wants.
